title: 3D Print Farm Tracker
summary: Track a print request from intake through production, quality checks and delivery. This browser tool records who asked for a part, the agreed printing instructions and the result, and can generate a traceability report. It does not slice models or launch printers.
features: Requester, part, quantity, date, notes and an optional pasted request email.
Material, colour, machine, layer height, infill, temperature, priority and finishing requirements.
New, Instructions Ready, Printing, QC, Completed, Delivered and On Hold.
Produced quantity, pass/rework/reprint result, notes, operator/date and a finished-part photo.
Generate a traceability report for print/PDF and export a CSV job log.
Connect a data folder when browser support and permission allow it.
workflows: Choose + New Request. Enter the requester and part details, quantity and due date. Pasting an email keeps it as reference; fill the structured fields yourself.
Choose Save Request and note the REQ identifier. Use that identifier in team communications so similarly named parts are not confused.
Complete Instructions for Team, including machine, material, layer height and any tolerances/finishing. Save Instructions before changing status.
Move the request to Instructions Ready when instructions are agreed, then Printing when production actually begins. The status itself does not start a machine.
Record actual quantity produced, QC result, notes and who completed the work. Add a photo if appropriate and Save Production Info.
Use Fail - reprint or Fail - rework when that is the result. Do not mark Delivered merely because printing finished.
Export and retain the job record
Generate Traceability Report and review requester, part, print specifications and QC information before Print / Save PDF.
Export the CSV job log for a summary across requests; the detailed report is a separate artifact.
Use Connect data folder if supported and confirm the saving status. The page explicitly says Not saving to a folder when no folder is connected.
limits: The screenshot contains a fictional request. No real requester details were copied. This tracker is independent of Parts Bench and does not imply automatic printer communication.
